newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Moevenpick CEO says ROE higher in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Moevenpick CEO says ROE higher in 1996.

text.p: Swiss food and hotel group Moevenpick AG said its return on equity (ROE) had risen for the fourth year in a row in 1996 and "highly satisfactory" results would be announced in the near future.
Chief executive Ulrich Geissmann also said in an interview with the weekly Swiss business paper HandelsZeitung that Moevenpick had achieved considerable progress in 1996.
A Moevenpick spokeswoman said the company would announce some 1996 results during next week, but which results and the exact day were not yet clear.
In November Geissmann said Moevenpick expected to report a group profit of 18 million Swiss francs, an increase of 2.8 million francs from the previous year.

Geissmann also told HandelsZeitung that Moevenpick's largest problem was its traditional restaurants and the company still had not achieved its goals here, even if the segment would show an operating profit in 1996.
"The same holds true for entire Moevenpick," Geissmann said.
Geismann said Moevenpick's hotel division had strengthened its profitability and increased sales last year, despite the difficult situation in the industry.
